title: End of Days
wikitext:
Russian Quake clan created specifically for playing in [[Villains Season 2]]. The clan was created at the end of 1999, hence the name.
Unfortunately, at that time the clan could not find a normal place for games with a high-quality connection, so all matches were played with a huge ping and pl. == Information == * '''Founded:''' December of [[1999]] by {{Player|gLAd|flag=ru}} * '''Nationality:''' [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] Russian * '''Clan prefix:''' ED ==Achievements== * Villains 2 - group stage == Former members == {{player|Brat|flag=ru}}
